actual_scope: At p=19, beta0=-1/2, bandwidth 2, and t_i=i, is the 2-norm of the normalized Schur matrix itself strictly below 19^10?
scope_change_reason: The inverse 2-norm is strictly below 319/100, which is strictly below 19^10. The named next step is the 2-norm of the matrix itself.
bottleneck_link: FINE-PRIME.md asks for both ||H||_2 and ||H^{-1}||_2 to be at most p^10. On this section every absolute row and column sum is strictly below 1226/625, so ||H||_2 is strictly below 1226/625 and hence below 19^10.
stop_rule: Stop once the matrix 2-norm is compared with 19^10. Do not form Q = I - p^{-20} H* H.
evidence: research/gaussian-origin-matrix-norm bounds all six normalized absolute row sums and column sums by 1226/625. Their product is strictly below (1226/625)^2, and 1226/625 < 2 < 6131066257801.
